sourceProxy: sum over readable original entries of ceil(UTF-8 source-text bytes / 3)
releasedProxy: intersection of currently active original entries and entries before the actual cut; excludes old notes and already archived originals

pause.policy: dispatch recovery immediately after successful commit; measure orchestration separately

ratios.writerOverhead: sum of known writer input+output+cache-read+cache-write tokens across successful, failed and discarded calls / sum of actual released-source proxy tokens at committed checkpoints
ratios.recoveryFootprint: (rendered note + lineage + continuation + retained originals, all source-proxy units) / released-source proxy
ratios.retrievalOverhead: known extra provider token usage after retrieval / released-source proxy

missingUsage: null with missing-call count; never silently zero; scripted placeholders are not provider measurements
cache: report provider cache fields only when supplied; never infer a hit from a stable prefix

hostFootprint.measure: git diff --no-index --numstat for each paired UTF-8 file; sum additions and deletions; do not count context lines

failedAttemptRelease: Record prepared release separately; actual released-source proxy is zero when no checkpoint commits. Ratios with a zero denominator are null, not zero.
